name: Chutes
short: Decentralized inference on Bittensor with flat per-token rates and confidential TEE compute - no subscription required, plus optional monthly plans and self-serve private GPU deployments.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Top up and pay per token; e.g. DeepSeek-V4-Flash $0.44/$1.32, Kimi K2.6 $0.45/$1.95, Qwen3.5-397B $0.45/$3.00. No free tier (stated in the FAQ).

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 2,000 requests/day included and 6% off pay-as-you-go rates beyond the quota.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 5,000 requests/day included and 10% off pay-as-you-go rates beyond the quota.

plans.name: Private Chutes
plans.notes: Deploy your own chute on a self-serve confidential TEE GPU (RTX Pro 6000, 96 GB), billed per second plus a one-time fee of 3x the hourly rate.
